title: SK Hynix To Be Kioxia S Top Shareholder After Bond Conversion

inline_images.alt: Bloomberg · Photographer: David Paul Morris/Bloomberg

author: Bloomberg
content_snippet:
SK Hynix to Be Kioxia’s Top Shareholder Yoolim Lee Fri, November 20, 2026 at 12:01 AM PST 1 min read 285A.T -11.66% SKHY -7.63% (Bloomberg) -- SK Hynix Inc. will become Kioxia Holdings Corp.'s largest shareholder after it converts its holdings of the Japanese company's bonds into shares.

Anthropic Raises $107.3 Billion to Top SpaceX's Record Debut

The South Korean memory titan announced on Friday a plan for the conversion and said its stake in Kioxia will be 14.1%.
summary_en: SK Hynix has announced plans to convert its holdings of Kioxia bonds into equity, resulting in a 14.1% stake and making the South Korean memory giant the largest shareholder in the Japanese storage manufacturer. This move is designed to deepen supply chain cooperation within the memory sector and strengthen strategic leverage in the NAND flash market.

ai_analysis.briefing_en: SK Hynix has announced plans to convert its holdings of Kioxia bonds into equity, resulting in a 14.1% stake and making the South Korean memory giant the largest shareholder in the Japanese storage manufacturer. title: Combatting adversarial distillation
title_en: Combatting adversarial distillation

inline_images.caption: Our defenses against adversarial distillation combine safeguards for individual requests with campaign detection and enforcement. Findings from investigations and automated red-teaming help strengthen those safeguards.
inline_images.caption_en: Our defenses against adversarial distillation combine safeguards for individual requests with campaign detection and enforcement. Findings from investigations and automated red-teaming help strengthen those safeguards.

author: OpenAI
content_snippet:
How we’re addressing safety risks of distillation and lessons we’ve learned for strengthening safeguards across the industry.

As frontier AI models become more capable, safeguards play an increasingly important role in how they can be used responsibly. Adversarial distillation creates a path for bad actors to reproduce these capabilities without appropriate safeguards. An actor may use a frontier model’s outputs without authorization to train another model with similar capabilities, then deploy
summary_en: OpenAI has deployed enhanced safeguards to mitigate adversarial distillation, focusing on protecting Chain-of-thought and intermediate reasoning traces. Through multi-layered defenses in GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models, internal benchmarks demonstrate that the success rate for attackers extracting protected reasoning has dropped from 54.0% in GPT-6 Astra to 0.2% in the updated version.
subheadings: Why distillation is a safety issue
The importance of protecting exact reasoning traces for cyber safety
The national security implications of adversarial distillation
How others can build on this work
title_zh: OpenAI强化模型防护，阻断对抗性蒸馏
summary_zh: OpenAI通过升级防护架构，大幅提升GPT-6.2 Astra在对抗性蒸馏中的鲁棒性，将模型推理痕迹提取成功率降至0.2%

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: OpenAI针对对抗性蒸馏（Adversarial Distillation）风险部署了更新的防护措施，重点保护模型的思维链（Chain-of-thought）及中间推理痕迹。通过在GPT-6.2 Astra及Sol模型中引入多层级防御，其内部测试显示攻击者获取受保护推理信息的成功率已从GPT-6 Astra的54.0%降至0.2%。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: OpenAI has deployed enhanced safeguards to mitigate adversarial distillation, focusing on protecting Chain-of-thought and intermediate reasoning traces. Through multi-layered defenses in GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models, internal benchmarks demonstrate that the success rate for attackers extracting protected reasoning has dropped from 54.0% in GPT-6 Astra to 0.2% in the updated version.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI在模型安全防护架构与API部署层：通过对抗性训练与API级防护，阻断对抗性蒸馏与中间推理痕迹泄露
【起因与机理】防止恶意攻击者通过蒸馏手段复刻模型能力，绕过安全审计进行网络攻击
【关键数据与实测】量化实测：GPT-6.2 Astra在红队测试中实现0.2%的极低被攻击成功率。
【各方立场与态度】技术手段：集成对抗性训练、分类器过滤与API级推理保护。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] OpenAI: Deploying adversarial training and API-level protections to prevent model distillation and reasoning trace extraction
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To prevent unauthorized actors from replicating model capabilities for malicious use
[Key Metrics] Quantified results: 0.2% attack success rate on GPT-6.2 Astra in red-teaming tests.
[Key Position & Outlook] Technical approach: Integrating adversarial training, classifiers, and API-level inference protection.

title: Hermes Agent's Collective Wisdom feature turns one employee's AI trick into the whole team's skill
title_en: Hermes Agent's Collective Wisdom feature turns one employee's AI trick into the whole team's skill
author: Jonathan Kemper
content_snippet:
Companies will soon be able to run the open-source Hermes Agent from Nous Research directly inside Microsoft Teams. According to Nous Research, employees can hand off tasks like financial analysis, document drafting, or inbox sorting to Hermes and review the results in the same chat. The desktop app is also available in the Microsoft Store. The agents run in Azure Container Apps Sandboxes, meaning isolated microVMs.

Hermes automatically turns successful workflows into reusable skills made up of
summary_en: AI research lab Nous Research has launched an enterprise version of Hermes Agent, integrated into Microsoft Teams and secured within Azure Container Apps sandboxes. The new 'Collective Wisdom' feature enables employees to convert successful automated workflows into team-wide shared assets, while ensuring that internal operational data is excluded from third-party model training.

title: AI Threatens to Make China’s Jobs Slump Much Worse
title_en: AI Threatens to Make China’s Jobs Slump Much Worse

author: Bloomberg
content_snippet:
Wider use of AI within organizations will lead to more jobs being created than are lost by 2030, according to Gartner.

Around 10.6 million jobs will be added globally (excluding China and India) by the end of the decade, with 8.9 million lost, according to a Gartner report — a net increase of 1.7 million jobs. At most, around 1.8% of the workforce will experience job losses attributable to AI during this time period, Gartner predicts.

At the same time, a total of 5 million jobs will cumulative
summary_en: Gartner projects a net gain of 1.7 million jobs by 2030, with 10.6 million created against 8.9 million lost globally. Chief forecaster John Lovelock notes that firms are transitioning from 'deferred hiring' to productive deployment, expecting a rebound in labor demand as AI systems move past the Trough of Disillusionment.
title_zh: Gartner预测2030年AI驱动就业净增长
summary_zh: 调研机构Gartner最新报告指出，尽管短期内AI引发岗位流失，但到2030年全球将通过AI创造更多就业机会

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: Gartner发布分析报告预测，至2030年全球将新增约1060万个就业岗位，抵消890万个流失岗位，实现170万的净增长。首席预测分析师John Lovelock指出，企业正经历由“暂缓招聘”转向“AI生产力落地”的周期，预计随着AI度过技术成熟度曲线的幻灭期，就业供需将趋于平衡。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Gartner projects a net gain of 1.7 million jobs by 2030, with 10.6 million created against 8.9 million lost globally. Chief forecaster John Lovelock notes that firms are transitioning from 'deferred hiring' to productive deployment, expecting a rebound in labor demand as AI systems move past the Trough of Disillusionment.

【起因与机理】AI从初步测试期向规模化落地转型，驱动系统性人才需求变动

title: Google is rolling out a collapsible sidebar on its desktop Search homepage, letting users easily find and resume recent AI searches (Barry Schwartz/Search Engine Roundtable)
title_en: Google is rolling out a collapsible sidebar on its desktop Search homepage, letting users easily find and resume recent AI searches (Barry Schwartz/Search Engine Roundtable)
author: Search Engine Roundtable
content_snippet:
Google is now officially rolling out what it calls the "collapsible sidebar" within Google Search. We spotted this a few weeks ago and we called it then the AI Mode sidebar in Google Search. Robby Stein from Google said "New on the Google desktop homepage globally: we’re rolling out a collapsible sidebar to easily find & jump back into your recent AI searches."

Robby Stein posted a video of this on X and wrote, "People are coming to Search with more questions that aren’t just one and done – and
summary_en: Google has officially rolled out a collapsible sidebar on its desktop Search homepage, a strategic move by its search experience division to enhance continuity for users engaged in multi-turn AI queries. title: Singapore-Based DayOne Is Said to Pause US IPO Plans on Data Center, Market Concerns
title_en: Singapore-Based DayOne Is Said to Pause US IPO Plans on Data Center, Market Concerns

inline_images.caption: DayOne was initially intending to raise as much as US$5 billion (S$6.45 billion) from an IPO as soon as the fourth quarter.
inline_images.alt: DayOne was initially intending to raise as much as US$5 billion (S$6.45 billion) from an IPO as soon

author: Bloomberg
content_snippet:
SINGAPORE – DayOne Data Centers has put plans for its multibillion-dollar US initial public offering on hold, sources familiar with the matter said, as investors question the sustainability of frothy valuations for digital infrastructure supporting the artificial intelligence boom.

But it started to reassess options including a delay or a smaller listing as volatility increased around data centres and AI stocks.

Singapore-based DayOne may still pursue an IPO in 2027 if the situation and market
summary_en: Singapore-based DayOne Data Centers has shelved its planned US IPO amid cooling market valuations for AI infrastructure and intensifying regulatory scrutiny. Despite efforts to navigate the AI compute demand surge, the company faces significant headwinds from investor skepticism regarding data center asset sustainability and strict US regulations on the export of advanced AI hardware to entities with China-linked operations.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 新加坡DayOne Data Centers受全球AI基础设施市场估值回落及地缘监管趋严影响，正式搁置其原定的美国IPO计划。公司曾试图通过在融资过程中解决AI算力需求与监管准入的矛盾，但市场对数据中心资产价值的持续质疑以及美国针对向中国相关实体输出高阶AI芯片的最新监管规则，迫使公司不得不重新评估上市时间窗口。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Singapore-based DayOne Data Centers has shelved its planned US IPO amid cooling market valuations for AI infrastructure and intensifying regulatory scrutiny. Despite efforts to navigate the AI compute demand surge, the company faces significant headwinds from investor skepticism regarding data center asset sustainability and strict US regulations on the export of advanced AI hardware to entities with China-linked operations.

title: Samsung names Choi Won-Joon head of its mobile division, replacing TM Roh, who stays as Samsung co-CEO, and Sang Joon Hwang to lead its memory business (Ben Schoon/9to5Google)
title_en: Samsung names Choi Won-Joon head of its mobile division, replacing TM Roh, who stays as Samsung co-CEO, and Sang Joon Hwang to lead its memory business (Ben Schoon/9to5Google)
author: 9to5Google
content_snippet:
After the better part of 7 years, Samsung’s mobile division has a new chief and it’s Choi Won-Joon, who is already off to a great start with the successful launch of Galaxy Z Fold 8.

In an announcement today, Samsung confirmed some shuffling of its executive team, most notably with the end of TM Roh’s tenure as the head of Samsung’s MX business unit. In other words, there’s a new captain at the helm for Samsung’s mobile division, and it’s Choi Won-Joon.

Won-Joon has been the Chief Operating Of
summary_en: Samsung Electronics has announced a leadership transition in its MX (Mobile Experience) business unit, appointing Chief Operating Officer Choi Won-Joon as the new head of the mobile division to oversee post-Galaxy S26 and Z Fold 8 product strategy. TM Roh will step down from the mobile leadership role but will retain his position as Samsung Electronics co-CEO, focusing on broader corporate strategy and cross-divisional integration.

paragraphs_zh: 随着通往通用超级人工智能（ASI）的多种技术路径逐步成型，后 AGI 时代的研究范式正从哲学思辨迅速转变为实证科学与系统性治理课题。
数十年来，全球人工智能学术与工业界始终聚焦于一座里程碑：构建通用人工智能（AGI）——即在几乎所有认知任务上均能与人类智力匹敌的智能系统。在原理上，智能超越人类心智极限是必然演进，但由于 AGI 曾被视作遥不可及且充满巨大不确定性，跨越它去探讨更远未来曾显得为时过早。
然而，当 AGI 已清晰步入人类视野与现实技术射程之内，我们再也无法推迟对“AGI 之后”的严肃审视。AI 极有可能以现有惊人节奏持续演进，甚至开启加速正反馈，向通用超级人工智能（ASI）跃迁。其对科学发现、宏观经济与人类社会结构的重塑烈度与传导速度，将远超 AGI 本身。为这一历史性范式转移做准备，亟需系统梳理从 AGI 通向 ASI 的技术路线图，并建立严谨可量化的评估观测体系。
为了科学剖析前沿 AI 的演化轨迹，将生物智能与人工机器智能视作同一连续谱系至关重要。人类水平的 AGI 仅是该智能演化光谱上的一个特定路标。
超级智能（ASI）位于连续谱系的更高阶：它是一种能够以更少算力资源和极短时间，在耗费人类顶级专家团队数年乃至数十年协同攻关的复合复杂任务中，持续且全方位压倒人类专家集群的高阶系统。例如在几周内完成整个科学领域原本需要数年的突破，或在芯片微架构研发上达成跨国科技巨头全年的研发产出。更为核心的是，ASI 必须在人类关切的几乎所有任务领域均达到此一基准，而非仅局限于狭义垂直领域。
在数学理论层面，我们对智能连续谱系的极值——即通用智能的理论物理与计算极限拥有坚实的理解。我们熟知算力、逻辑复杂度和物理维度的硬约束，诸如对气候混沌系统、人体复杂免疫机制及人类宏观经济行为的绝对预测上限。
然而知晓物理极限并不能回答通往极限之前的曲率。即便在理论推导中，准确预言一个“足够优秀”的工程近似智能能够迸发出何种效能亦极度困难。正如完美破解国际象棋的算力需求远超地球总和，但一块微缩芯片的工程启发式算法即可击败全人类大师。
我们唯一确证的是，根本性物理极限远在当今 AI 系统与人类智力之上。但在人类水平 AGI 与理论极限之间的广袤空间，即涵盖专家级 AGI 与各层级超级智能的庞大技术阶梯，目前仍是几乎完全未被涉足的处女地。
过去十年中，前沿 AI 能力的飞跃源自有效算力的指数级复合增长，由三大核心引擎持续驱动：硬件能效微架构跃升、算法大规模扩展，以及架构本身的突破。随着前沿 AI 从基础感知走向自主科学推理，自动化科研的正反馈闭环将从根本上决定迈向超级智能的时代时间线。
full_text:
As multiple technological routes toward artificial general superintelligence take shape, the regime beyond AGI is shifting from philosophical speculation to empirical research and governance questions.

For decades, AI research has been focused on a monumental milestone: building artificial general intelligence, or AGI — machines that match humans across nearly all cognitive tasks. It was always clear that, in principle, intelligence could progress beyond human level, but the prospect of AGI was far enough off, and surrounded by ample uncertainties of its own, that looking past it felt premature.

Now that AGI is coming within reach, we can no longer put off seriously considering what comes next. While far from certain, AI could continue to advance at its current pace — and possibly even accelerate — towards artificial general superintelligence, or ASI. It could have a profound impact on science, the economy, and society at a scale and speed much greater than AGI itself. Preparing for that potential shift requires mapping the possible roads from AGI to ASI and building rigorous, reliable ways to track progress.

To examine how the development of advanced AI might unfold, it helps to think of general intelligence, whether biological or artificial, as existing on a continuum. Human-level AGI is just one point along that spectrum.

ASI sits further along as an advanced system that consistently outperforms large groups of human experts on tasks that could take them years to complete, using fewer resources and less time. Examples would be making the same scientific progress as an entire research field in a fraction of the time, or achieving technological developments, such as in chip design, on par with what large companies can do in a year. ASI would need to meet this bar across virtually all tasks of human interest, not just some in narrow domains.

Interestingly, we have a good mathematical understanding of the very upper end of the intelligence continuum — the theoretical limits of general intelligence. We also know about hard physical, logical, and complexity-theoretic limits to what AI can achieve, such as predicting how real-world complex systems — from climate to immune systems to human societies — play out with arbitrary precision.

Yet knowing those upper limits doesn’t tell us what comes before them. Even in theory, it’s hard to predict how capable a ‘good enough’ approximation of general intelligence can be. For example, solving chess perfectly requires far more computing power than exists on Earth, yet a thumbnail-sized chip can play the game well enough to defeat any human.

What we do know is that fundamental limits lie far beyond both today’s AI systems and humans. But the vast space between human-level AI and theoretical limits to intelligence, which encompasses expert AGI and a whole regime of more and more advanced superintelligent systems, is largely uncharted.

Over the last ten years, AI progress was fueled by steady growth in effective compute, driven by three compounding factors: hardware efficiency, algorithmic scaling, and structural model improvements. As frontier AI moves from perception to autonomous scientific reasoning, the compounding feedback loops of automated research will fundamentally dictate the timeline toward superintelligence.

paragraphs_zh: 伦敦人工智能药物研发初创公司 Boltz 正式宣布完成 1.1 亿美元的 A 轮融资，距离其走出隐形模式不足一年。
Boltz 是一家专注于开发加速药物发现 AI 模型的前沿研究机构。该公司最初由麻省理工学院（MIT）孵化，现总部设立于英国伦敦国王十字科技核心区，拥有 40 位顶尖人工智能研究员。
本轮融资由 Bessemer Venture Partners 领投，现有投资方 Andreessen Horowitz（a16z）、Amplify Partners、Zetta Venture Partners 与 Obvious Ventures 悉数跟投。
新加入的战略投资机构包括 Greycroft、F-Prime Capital、Hummingbird 与 Benchling；英伟达（Nvidia）亦在今年早些时候黄仁勋访英期间宣布了对该公司的战略投资。此前 Boltz 曾于今年初完成 2800 万美元种子轮融资。
该初创公司构建的软件平台能够协助制药巨头与生物科技科研人员精准设计候选药物，并科学筛选最具潜力的分子进入实验室实测。
其底层 AI 模型能够高精度预测蛋白质与候选药物分子结合时的三维结构形态，准确评估结合亲和力，并主动生成专门针对特定靶点的新型活性分子。公司通过开源模型及其商业化企业平台和 API 两种模式提供能力。
在麻省理工学院期间，联合创始人团队发布了与 DeepMind 旗下 AlphaFold3 性能匹敌的开源前沿模型，这些模型现已成为全球早期药物发现的行业默认基准。
Boltz 已宣布与辉瑞（Pfizer）、葛兰素史克（GSK）、武田制药（Takeda）以及百时美施贵宝（Bristol Myers Squibb）等跨国药企建立深度研发合作。商业化收入主要来自于战略科研合作授权以及企业级平台与模型 API 访问订阅。
Boltz 表示，本轮筹集的资金将重点用于扩大算力基础设施集群、采购前沿生物数据集，并进一步扩充顶尖研究团队。

paragraphs_zh: 《侠盗猎车手VI》（Grand Theft Auto VI）于周四正式发售，在这款有望成为历史上规模最大视频游戏大作的狂潮下，全球网络主播迎来了一场流量盛宴，部分创作者甚至计划进行通宵不间断的马拉松式直播狂欢。
亚马逊旗下核心流媒体平台 Twitch 官方宣布，R星（Rockstar Games）这款扛鼎大作的上线成为该平台“历史上规模最大的单一游戏启动事件”，开播数小时内即创下330万峰值并发观众的历史新纪录。
华尔街金融分析机构与行业专家普遍预测，凭借打破行业纪录的预售热潮、高溢价豪华版捆绑包以及历经13年沉淀的庞大全球粉丝基本盘，《GTA VI》发售最初几个月内的全球流水收入预计将轻松突破30亿美元大关。
包括 Kai Cenat、IShowSpeed 和 xQc 在内的顶级创作者将开放世界地图的探索转化为极具吸睛效应的网络真人秀，单日直播时长普遍达12至24小时。主播们通过观众订阅与打赏自动延长直播倒计时的机制，将游戏初体验推升为全球玩家共同参与的数字嘉年华。

author: Reuters
content_snippet:
Korea surpassed $1 trillion in annual exports for the first time Thursday, reaching the milestone at 2:09:38 p.m. as global AI investment boosted demand for semiconductors. It became the fourth country to reach the mark, after the United States, Germany and China. The government projects exports will total about $1.17 trillion this year, but officials warned that AI investment slowdowns, chip-price volatility and trade barriers could threaten momentum.

Containers are stacked at a port in Incheo

paragraphs_zh: 人工智能独角兽 Anthropic PBC 在其创纪录的全球首次公开募股（IPO）中，向英国及欧洲大陆的散户投资者定向发售了总值达11亿美元的股票，创下全球资本市场历史上针对散户的最大规模科技股配售纪录。
彭博社查阅的监管备案文件显示，这家开发了 Claude 聊天机器人的前沿 AI 实验室向英国零售投资者配售了略超360万股股票，并向欧盟、挪威及瑞士的散户配售了近970万股股票。
尽管此前市场对生成式 AI 巨额算力资本开支的可持续性及二级市场震荡有所疑虑，但 Anthropic 及其联合创始人团队依然克服了重重阻力，将最终 IPO 发行价定于推介区间顶端之上，累计募资规模达1073亿美元。公司周四在纽约纳斯达克的正式挂牌使其成为全球首家登陆公开市场的顶级 AI 前沿实验室。
按照每股83美元的发行价计算，Anthropic 分别通过英国本土平台配售和欧洲大陆跨境销售筹集了约3亿美元与8.01亿美元资金。这一零售发售规模显著超过了埃隆·马斯克旗下 SpaceX 此前向英国储蓄者发售的3.64亿美元以及向欧洲大陆散户配售的逾6亿美元纪录。
在英国市场，Anthropic 充分利用了英国创新的公开发行平台监管框架（Public-Offer Platforms Regime），在无需单独编制繁复本地招股说明书的前提下直接对接个人投资者。该笔发售由 RetailBook 投资平台领衔协调，AJ Bell、哈格里夫斯-兰斯当（Hargreaves Lansdown）以及数字银行巨头 Revolut 等经纪商共同承担了散户订单报送与划转。
而在欧洲大陆地区，Anthropic 面向德国、丹麦、芬兰、法国、爱尔兰、荷兰、挪威、西班牙、瑞典和瑞士的散户推出了全欧区域性配售方案，该承销团由包括法国巴黎银行（BNP Paribas SA）、德意志银行（Deutsche Bank AG）和瑞士联合银行（UBS Group AG）在内的欧洲顶级银行集团及 Trade Republic、盛宝银行（Saxo Bank）等数字券商联手护航。
